nonblocking_findings.title: projectDisplayLevel uses levels[0]! without runtime guard for empty arrays
nonblocking_findings.description: projectDisplayLevel in level-projection.ts uses levels[0]! (non-null assertion) which would throw on an empty levels array. The displayLevelSchema .min(1) refinement protects the public API path through Zod validation, but direct function calls with empty arrays bypass validation and crash. Test-strategy §10.5 explicitly says 'projectDisplayLevel should fail safely on invalid levels.' This was already documented as ADV-P6-N1 and marked 'Green-deferred (non-blocking)' in the plan.
